summary: Franklin Resources, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on July 30, 2026. The agreement amends a revolving credit facility, increasing aggregate commitments to $1.5 billion with an option to increase by $500 million, and extends maturity to July 31, 2031. As of closing, $700 million was outstanding. Interest rates are based on Base Rate or Term SOFR plus margins depending on the company's debt rating. This is a routine credit facility refinancing, not a special situation. No deal terms are announced; watchers should monitor borrowing levels and covenant compliance.
